Analysis

Era 2 of 8

1960 to 1974: Decolonisation

Opened by: 17 African states admitted in 1960; Council enlarged to 15 in 1965.

Africa rises to 27% of resolutions. First mandatory sanctions, on Southern Rhodesia (232 (1966)). First "Acting under Chapter VII" (253 (1968)). The UK casts 10 vetoes; the US casts its first in 1970.

234resolutions
16per year
57%adopted unanimously
37vetoed drafts
1%under Chapter VII

What rose in the texts

Subjects whose share of resolutions grew by 5 points or more on the previous era.

  • Peacekeeping: 0% to 14%
  • Self-determination and decolonisation: 0% to 10%
  • Human rights: 0% to 6%
  • Sanctions and embargoes: 1% to 6%

Vetoes

37 vetoed drafts. No votes by permanent members on them: USSR / Russia 23, United States 6, United Kingdom 10, France 1, China 2. 22 further drafts failed for lack of votes.
